newsitem.title: USA: Lubrizol Corp buys CPI Engineering Services.
newsitem.headline: Lubrizol Corp buys CPI Engineering Services.

text.p: Lubrizol Corp Monday said it has acquired CPI Engineering Services Inc and expects the acquisition to be accretive to earnings in 1997.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Based in Midland, Mich., CPI is a formulator of specialty synthetic lubricants used by original equipment manufacturers in air and refrigeration compressors.

CPI had sales in 1996 of approximately $20 million and has grown at an average rate of over 20 percent per year since 1991. Lubrizol said it will operate CPI as a separately incorporated subsidiary and will merge its own synthetic refrigerant lubricants business into CPI.
Lubrizol will continue to maintain its substantial patent holdings for these synthetic products and will make technology available by license to other companies.
